notes: Shorthand/CRM notes: inbound lead from product analytics event. CTO Rafael Gomez: 'We need predictable monthly cost, can't have token spikes that blow our budget.' Primary goal: in-app semantic product search + personalized recommendations. Started with Hosted API POC to validate embedding quality and reranking flow. POC observations: embeddings quality acceptable; recall top-5 improved ~22% vs baseline BM25 on canonical dataset. Pain: nightly batch of ~2M rows caused cost spikes and long runtimes on Hosted. They want a Dedicated reserved pool (VPC preferred) so batch jobs run during off-peak with predictable unit cost. Strong requirement for audit logs and KMS-managed keys (enterprise procurement). Data residency: must keep EU customer data in eu-* regions. Team notes: product team is small (6) but infra/data team will own deployment. AE/Jared: push pricing that shows cost per 100k embeddings + delta for quantized model option. Good fit for Redwood Optimize suggestions (auto-batching + quant profiles).
poc_notes: Hosted POC metrics: 50k docs indexed, embedding model: open-embed-002 (trial). Avg embed generation time per doc: 42ms (hosted), cost est: $0.15 per 1k embeddings at POC rates. Semantic queries: 95th p latency 120ms (hosted). Quality: top-5 MRR +22% vs BM25. Issues: nightly batching of 2M rows projected -> estimated monthly token cost exceeds target. Customer requests quantized model variants + Dedicated pricing to reduce unit cost.
